comparison: Nine prior fixed cases; three original content policies (none, exact, deadband); two frozen fused models; each with withholding or radar fallback; plus always-radar comparator = 13 policies, 117 case-policy combinations. No guard threshold/model/label/schedule changes. none retains original timestamp/quality checks.
fixed_metrics: Retain all 37340 requests per case/policy; overall, before/during/after and each fixed 300s segment. Report accepted errors, denominators, branch status counts, route counts, source switches and consecutive <=50ms prediction steps. Joint gate requires availability >=.95, P95 <=.5m/s, zero missing accepted references and zero accepted >2m/s errors. Small accepted cohorts alone cannot pass availability.
limitations: Repeatedly inspected development data and correlated request trials
Reference/frame discrepancy including OBD calibration_0 P95 .539887m/s remains unresolved
Threshold-aware pulses may evade the gate and prevent fallback
No simultaneous radar/peer attack, live latency, closed-loop safety or independent final evaluation
Engineering selectors are ablations, not reproduced 2025/2026 published AV systems
scope: One fixed offline source-selection engineering comparison after observed fault failures; reused Urban01 NIGHT development only. No final-test, attack-detection, novelty, or published-system reproduction claim.
selection_rule: Prefer eligible primary. If primary unavailable and fallback enabled, use independently eligible radar-only. Otherwise abstain. Never inspect labels, case identity, future records or errors when routing. Preserve both statuses and selected endpoint/age. Fused rejections remain fused rejections; a degraded radar estimate is a distinct numerical serving result, not an ACL/capability grant.
source_scope: Only recorded IMU is perturbed in these cases. Radar and shared peer are not independently authenticated by this work. Their availability under IMU faults is a scenario assumption, not a guarantee under radar/peer/common-mode compromise.

status_meaning.4: original quality or source/content binding rejection

switching_rule: Immediate stateless preference, no hysteresis, dwell timer, smoothing or blending. Prediction-step metrics are replay discontinuity diagnostics, not calibrated physical acceleration or control stability.
verification_scope: Trust prior exact-hash verified base/content overlays; independently reconstruct selection per request and scalar metrics. This update does not repeat raw sensor feature or model inference verification. Record that boundary explicitly.
